1.name: TEMP
1.hint: battery NTC input: charging is suspended while TEMP is below 45 % or above 80 % of VCC; TEMP to GND disables the temperature sense (p. 7, p. 10)

2.name: PROG
2.hint: charge current IBAT = 1100 V / RPROG; PROG regulated to 1 V in constant-current mode; PROG open = shutdown; keep its capacitance small (p. 7, 9, 11, 13); absolute maximum -0.3 … VCC + 0.3 V

needs.source: NanJing Top Power ASIC Corp. TP4056 '1A Standalone Linear Li-Ion Battery Charger' REV_2.4, p. 9 RPROG table: 1.1 kΩ → 1000 mA, the largest charge current the data sheet programs (p. 2 'up to 1000 mA'); IBAT = 1100 / RPROG (p. 7, 9)

4.name: VCC
4.hint: ceramic input capacitors can ring to high voltage when plugged into a live source – a 1.5 Ω resistor in series with the ceramic capacitor minimizes the transient (p. 13)

needs.source: NanJing Top Power ASIC Corp. TP4056 '1A Standalone Linear Li-Ion Battery Charger' REV_2.4, p. 3 typical applications: 10 µF at VCC (fig. 3 p. 12 shows 1 µF); no minimum stated, so no window entered

5.name: BAT
5.hint: battery +: float voltage 4.158 … 4.242 V; draws < 2 µA from the cell in sleep and shutdown (p. 5, 7); the data sheet's absolute maximum for BAT is misprinted ('-0.3V~0.7V', p. 2) – no v_max_v entered

needs.source: NanJing Top Power ASIC Corp. TP4056 '1A Standalone Linear Li-Ion Battery Charger' REV_2.4, p. 3 typical applications: 10 µF at BAT; no minimum stated, so no window entered

6.name: STDBY#
6.hint: open drain: low when the charge cycle is complete, otherwise high impedance; VSTDBY ≤ 0.6 V at 5 mA; unused: to GND (p. 5, 7, 10)

7.name: CHRG#
7.hint: open drain: low while charging, otherwise high impedance; VCHRG ≤ 0.6 V at 5 mA; unused: to GND (p. 5, 7, 10)

8.name: CE
8.hint: chip enable: high = normal operation, low = shutdown; 'TTL or CMOS logic level' – no thresholds given (p. 7)

9.name: EP
9.hint: exposed pad: solder to PCB ground – the thermal path for the charge current (p. 13)

hints: charge current IBAT = 1100 V / RPROG (1.1 kΩ → 1 A, 2.2 kΩ → 0.5 A); trickle charge below 2.9 V; terminates at 1/10 of the programmed current after reaching 4.2 V; recharge below 4.05 V (p. 5, 8, 9)

dissipation PD = (VCC − VBAT) × IBAT; the internal thermal regulation reduces the charge current near 145 °C die temperature (p. 8, 12; p. 10 says about 140 °C, zero beyond 150 °C); no θJA rating in the data sheet
UVLO 3.5 … 3.9 V rising; charging starts only with VCC 60 … 140 mV above BAT (p. 5, 11)
